# Samartha Gamana Infra

Official site of Samartha Gamana Infra (SGI), a real-estate and infrastructure house.

## Founder

Nara Sudharshan is the founder and owner. He is from Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Work

Townships, residences (including 2 BHK), villas, houses, commercial, road infrastructure, construction, and land development. Cities include Anantapur, Kurnool, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Nandyal, Ballari, Kadapa, Gadwal, Warangal, and Tadipatri.

Gallery inventory on the site is sample stock unless confirmed on WhatsApp.
